source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of queue operations (PDF 101-102).

items: Enqueue: peeche cheez jorna, jaise koi qataar ke aakhir mein lage.
Dequeue: aage wali cheez nikalna, jaise pehle shakhs ki khidmat.
Doosre amal: queue khali hai ya nahi, aage wali cheez nikale baghair dekhna (peek), aur size maloom karna.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
from queue import Queue    # built-in module
q = Queue()
q.put("Ahmed")    # enqueue
q.put("Fatima")
q.put("Ali")
print(q.queue[0])    # peek: Ahmed
print(q.get())       # dequeue: Ahmed
q.put("Sara")
print(list(q.queue)) # ['Fatima', 'Ali', 'Sara']

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: list ki paanch cheezein Decorations, Snacks, Cold drinks, Plates, Balloons index 0 se 4 ke saath aur list ke amal ke notes. Oopar daen: Book A, Book B aur Book C ka stack, push oopar jorta aur pop Book C hatata hai. Neeche baen: queue Ahmed, Fatima, Ali, Sara, aage se dequeue aur peeche enqueue. Neeche daen: 3 4 5 * + nikalte waqt stack ki halatein [3], [3, 4], [3, 4, 5], [3, 20], [23].
blocks.caption: Lists, stacks, queues aur postfix evaluation (topics 4.1.1 se 4.1.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: List cheezon ko 0 se shuru hone wale index ke saath tarteeb mein rakhti hai, to Plates index 3 par hai, aur cheezein dakhil, aakhir mein jori, hatayi ya dhoondi ja sakti hain. Kitabon ka stack sirf oopar se istemal hota hai: push Book B aur Book A ke oopar Book C rakhta, aur pop pehle Book C hatata hai, jo aakhir mein aayi thi. Queue aage se khidmat karti aur peeche jorti hai: Ahmed, jo pehle aaya, pehle farigh hota hai, aur Sara Ali ke peeche lagti hai. 3 4 5 * + nikalne ke liye adad baari baari push hote hain; * 5 aur 4 nikal kar 20 push karta, phir + 20 aur 3 nikal kar jawab 23 push karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Queue mein cheez kaunsa amal jorta hai (MCQ 5)? Enqueue aur dequeue mein farq bataiye (short question 5).
blocks.explanation: (c) Enqueue. Enqueue queue ke peeche cheez jorta hai; dequeue aage wali cheez nikal kar lautata hai. Dono mil kar first-in, first-out tarteeb qaim rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Long question 5: print jobs ki queue ka Python code likhein: banayein, teen jobs jorein, aage wali dikhayein, nikalein, ek aur jorein aur queue dikhayein.
blocks.explanation: from queue import Queue; jobs = Queue(); jobs.put("Report.pdf"); jobs.put("Notes.docx"); jobs.put("Photo.png"); print("Front:", jobs.queue[0]); print("Printed:", jobs.get()); jobs.put("Slides.pptx"); print(list(jobs.queue)) Notes.docx, Photo.png, Slides.pptx dikhata hai. Files ke naam misal hain.
